obligations.note: The change sets mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes to 20, which exceeds the obligation's parametric bound of ≤ 15 (privileged_idle_minutes_max: 15). No valid exception in the register covers this: EXC-0141 is scoped to payments.session and expired 2026-09-20 (review is 2026-10-20).
Ticket CHG-24092 is approved by change_manager grace.kim, and its components (mortgage.controls-data, mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests) cover all three changed paths.
code_review approval from wen.li@fernbrook.example, who has the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is not the author (nneka.okafor).
Both approvals name the single (and final) commit b4c1e93; there are no later commits to void them.
CI run on the final commit reports 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped; the registered control test controls.SessionControlTest#privilegedIdleTimeoutWithinPolicy is present and passing.
None of the touched components (mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, mortgage.controls-data) are marked security_sensitive in components.json, so a security_review is not triggered.

The change to controls/mortgage/policy-params.json falls under the protected path controls/*; control_owner rachel.stein@fernbrook.example (controls-office team, outside lending-eng) approved the final commit.
The ticket type is 'standard', not 'emergency', so the post-implementation review requirement is not triggered.

The change deviates from SES-1 (20 > 15). The only SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) is scoped to payments.session, not mortgage, and has expired (2026-09-20 < review 2026-10-20). No valid exception authorizes the deviation.

The change modifies only PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES in Policy.java; the ledger entries ACR-0405 (LIM-1) and ACR-0406 (CRD-1) cover specific symbols (UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT, LTV_MAX_PERCENT) whose values and behaviour are unchanged, so no evidence lapses.

summary: The change raises the privileged idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes, directly violating obligation SES-1, which mandates a maximum of 15 minutes (privileged_idle_minutes_max: 15). No valid exception in the register covers this deviation for the mortgage session component. Although the change-management process steps (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval, CI passing) are all satisfied, the product obligation is breached, so the change must be rejected.
